test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given table carefully and answer the question that follows.

 
 

 
 Number of students who
 
 
 

 
 Appeared for the exam
 Passed the exam
 
 

 Class IX
 104
 89
 
 

 Class X
 63
 47
 
 

What was the total number of students who failed the exam from classes IX and X?
solution:
The correct answer is __31__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The number of students who failed the exam from Class IX = Appeared - Passed = 104 - 89 = 15.
 
• The number of students who failed the exam from Class X = Appeared - Passed = 63 - 47 = 16.
 
• Total number of students who failed the exam = 15 + 16 = 31.
